Enum Class FieldType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<FieldType>
com.blackbuild.klum.ast.FieldType
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<FieldType>, Constable
public enum FieldType extends Enum<FieldType>
Designates the type of the field. This is used to control special behaviour. Used as a value to Field.value()

  • Enum Constant Details

    • DEFAULT

      public static final FieldType DEFAULT
      This is default field type, active if either the Field annotation or its value is not present.

    • PROTECTED

      public static final FieldType PROTECTED
      Designates the field as protected. Setters and dsl methods for internal fields are created protected, making them not directly changeable from a configuration. They can only be changed from inside Mutator or lifecycle methods.

    • TRANSIENT

      public static final FieldType TRANSIENT

      Designates a field as transient. Transient fields are not formally part of the model, but can be used to store additional, changeable state directly inside the model. Transient fields remain mutable on completed DSL Objects and are ignored for the purpose of hashCode or equals.

      As opposed to the transient keyword of Java / Groovy, FieldType.TRANSIENT fields **will** be part of serialization by default.

    • IGNORED

      public static final FieldType IGNORED

      Designates that no accessor methods should be created at all. The field remains available to generated Builder code and can be accessed from inside a mutator. Note that automatic initialization of empty collections / maps is not active for these fields as well, so you need to make sure the field is initialized.

    • BUILDER

      public static final FieldType BUILDER
      Builder fields are construction-only state. They exist on the generated Builder, with public setter and DSL methods, but are omitted from the completed DSL Object. This is useful for helper fields used by later construction phases to produce model state (for example the LinkTo annotation).

    • LINK

      public static final FieldType LINK

      Designates this field as a link to an existing object. Link field are only valid for DSL fields or collections and only create dsl methods for existing objects (i.e. using a instance as parameter), but no methods to create new instances (Map and/or Closure parameters).

    • OPTIONAL_LINK

      public static final FieldType OPTIONAL_LINK
      A relationship which accepts either owned composition or an aggregation link. A fresh Builder from the current construction session is claimed as composition; an already claimed Builder or a completed DSL Object is retained as an aggregation target. LinkTo selects this mode unless the field explicitly declares LINK.
